diagnostics: Full raw and normalized content were hashed at acquisition but are not retained; replay verifies retained excerpts and metadata, not the discarded full document.

excerpts.quote: The situation with dollars reminds me of the situation of bitcoin on MtGox just before it collapsed. The bitcoin price on MtGox diverged from the price on other exchanges. To a casual user it looked like you were getting a good deal by buying it on MtGox but that's because the last people out wouldn't be able to actually withdraw it, because the promise of a bitcoin from an exchange is not the same thing as an actual bitcoin.

policy.review_note: Documented public Algolia HN search and original HN item API; search responses are discovery references only. Open actual item and verify identity, publication, text and live/not-deleted state. Retain at most two bounded relevant text excerpts with attribution/permalink and hashes; no author/profile/contact/like data or full response retention. Purpose sample is not representative market sentiment.
